target: Exact frozen Pattern A and Pattern B replay on the four common weekends before the 21 September 2026 international break

frozen_gate.meaning: Both teams must have at least eight earlier results in the same competition and season before any environment or player candidate can qualify.

evidence.international_window: FIFA men's international window: 21 September to 6 October 2026.
evidence.premier_league: The final pre-break weekend was Matchweek 5, leaving only four earlier league results per club at most.
evidence.la_liga: The final pre-break weekend was Matchday 7 after a midweek round, leaving only six earlier results per club at most.
evidence.bundesliga: The final pre-break weekend was Matchday 4, leaving only three earlier results per club at most.
evidence.serie_a_and_ligue_1: Both were also still in their opening rounds and below eight prior same-season results.

interpretation: This is a valid no-action backtest. Calculating candidates or a hit rate would require changing the frozen rule, such as carrying previous-season matches into history. That was not done.
